# iosxe_voice_class_e164_pattern_map (Data Source)

This data source can read the Voice Class E164 Pattern Map configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_voice_class_e164_pattern_map" "example" {
  tag = 200
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (Number) Voice class e164-pattern-map tag

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) e164 pattern map specific description
- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `patterns` (Attributes List) Set E164 pattern for the map (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--patterns))
- `url` (String) Set the URL of the file for the map

<a id="nestedatt--patterns"></a>
### Nested Schema for `patterns`

Read-Only:

- `pattern` (String) Add an E164 into the map
